data.name: Dragonheir: Silent Gods
data.detailed_description:
Dragonheir: Silent Gods — A high-freedom Western fantasy strategy RPG. Roll the fate-determining us twenty-sided dicelings and recruit 300+ outlander heroes to embark on an unscripted Epic adventure! Combining classic TRPG mechanics with strategic Magichess gameplay, elemental Bonds and skill clashes make every formation a potential game-changer.

◉New Version Highlights◉

〓 Ancient Awakening: Confront the Fear Lurking Within the Rift 〓

The ancient abomination "Temporal Vortex: Twin-Headed Serpent" devours entire planes and emerges from the rift! For the first time, a simultaneous dual-team deployment system is introduced, no hero duplication allowed. Only the most elite Travelers can overcome this ultimate threat through flawless strategy.

〓 Rifts Open: The World Transforms 〓

Inquietum surges, triggering Hero Awakenings across the battlefield! New champions like Ernesto, Angler of the Woesea, enter battle wielding Mythic sets and exclusive Artifacts. A new Familiar, the Hellfire Retainer, arrives to disrupt the battlefield with devastating control.

〓 Immersive Interactive H5 Story: Every Choice Rewrites Fate 〓

This time, the story unfolds beyond combat. The long-sealed history of Order and Chaos will be revealed day by day, uncovering the forbidden knowledge sealed away by the gods. You shall stand at destiny’s crossroads: each decision leads down a different path, granting one of 18 exclusive Legendary Hero Fatebound Heroes who resonate with your journey!

〓Boundless Freedom in Exploration〓

The sandbox open world features diverse landscapes, from shadowy forests to scorching deserts, mysterious underground realms to vast archipelagos—each hiding surprises waiting to be discovered. Create your protagonist freely, with your attribute choices influencing story directions. Roll dice to trigger random events and interact with NPCs to unlock hidden quests, experiencing an adventure journey filled with unknowns and extraordinary encounters!

〓Epic Benefit Discounts〓

Join the "Prophecy Summons" and "Account Appraisal" events now to get massive amounts of free summons and abundant resource packs!

The summoning system gets a complete overhaul in the Reborn version—single summons now only cost 100 Wyrmarrow, with 70% off summon privileges available immediately upon launch! You can also get additional Summon Dice and selectable Legendary heroes through the concurrent "Summon More, Get More" celebration event—building your desired lineup has never been easier. Command an army of champions!

〓Strategies Renewed and Upgraded〓

The brand-new Hero Talent system revolutionizes traditional progression! 300+ heroes each boasts 12 unique Talent effects, with no talent trees limiting your mixes and matches! Unlock exclusive battle abilities for your heroes and customize in-depth tactical styles! Make every battle your strategic masterpiece!

〓A Burden-Free Experience〓

Embracing the philosophy of returning to strategic gameplay, we've created the innovative "Resonance Level" system. Level up once, shared across your entire team! Gone are the days of individually leveling each character—now your entire roster benefits from shared progression, letting you focus on what truly matters: tactics and discovery!

data.short_description: The Inquietum fluctuates wildly, planar rifts widen, and anomalies sweep across the continent. New heroes awaken alongside Mythic Gear and exclusive Artifacts. The ancient evil Temporal Vortex: Hydra emerges, while new Familiars make their debut. Join the event, face Season 8!!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 7th generation or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NV GeForce 8600 GT, ATI Radeon HD2600XT or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 18 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: We advise you install the game on an SSD for a more streamlined experience.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 10th generation or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2050 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: We advise you install the game on an SSD for a more streamlined experience.
